cohort: A 51-year-old female who presented with an incidental finding of a right renal lesion during a health examination.
finding: A right renal vein aneurysm was diagnosed in a 51-year-old female, which showed no obvious enlargement but suspected arteriovenous fistula at 6-month follow-up, underscoring the report's objective to differentiate renal vascular disease from malignant renal neoplasms.
